name: Mission Sol-4: Guardians of Ares Base
description: 100% front-end bilingual educational Mars mission game (EN-US / PT-BR) featuring Commander Quack, native accessibility tools, and real NASA data (DONKI, OSDR, MEDA, and APOD), created by Maryangela Costa de Souza Florentin & Luna Costa Antunes for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
